_note: The route's strongest headwind (the engine's route_headwind): of the nav log's legs, the one whose wind aloft blows most against its true course, the wind's component along it (FAA-H-8083-25C ch. 16), a tailwind negative. Worked by hand: 20 kt from 270 on a 300 course is 20 cos 30 = 17.3 kt of headwind; 25 kt from 320 on a 320 course is 25; 30 kt from 180 on a 360 course is a 30 kt tailwind (-30); 10 kt from 250 on a 090 course is 10 cos 160 = -9.4. The engine (engine/facade/tests/route_headwind.rs) and the web (features/brief/glance.test.ts) are held to it.

cases.why: the leg flown most into the wind, a later one than the first
tailwinds all the way: the least of them, negative
a leg with no wind or no course passed over
no leg with a wind: none
